opus.problem: Grinding on handmills and boiling in pots (Numbers 11:8) is a small detail. Meanwhile, some of the best-known manna stories are unused: it was found on the ground each morning after the dew lifted (Exodus 16:13-14), and when kept overnight it bred worms and stank (Exodus 16:20). The 'known stories first' rule favors replacing this clue with one of those.
